subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should v2026.5.22-beta.1 receive retroactive signed/notarized macOS desktop assets and appcast-beta.xml, or should maintainers declare this beta train package-only and close or retarget the paired work?
rationale: Current main has no beta appcast, the prerelease still has no macOS assets, and docs currently allow beta macOS omission, so automation cannot choose the release policy or run private signing/notary credentials.

options.title: Declare no retroactive beta desktop assets
options.body: Document that this old beta train is package-only, then close this issue and retarget the paired PR to future beta policy if desired.

options.title: Land signed-beta gating first
options.body: Keep this issue open until the paired PR and any release-infra branch are reviewed, repaired, and ready to enforce beta desktop distribution going forward.

options.title: Publish retroactive beta assets
options.body: Run the private macOS signing/notary/publish path for v2026.5.22-beta.1 and commit appcast-beta.xml with a valid signed enclosure.

recommendation.title: Declare no retroactive beta desktop assets
recommendation.body: Document that this old beta train is package-only, then close this issue and retarget the paired PR to future beta policy if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release workflow and release-channel documentation work makes this the best available routing owner for the release-policy choice.
